„
— Unclean Eternal Debtor

Involvement

Act Three

The Unclean Eternal Debtor is within the House of Hope at X: -6507 Y: 2943. Though he does not disclose how he ended up in debt to  Raphael or what his punishment is, he fervently and jealously guards Raphael's chamber pot. If asked if he is its guardian, he claims to admire and protect it, describing it as his "one true love".
